7.2.4.15.1 Rte_Rips_SchM_Init
[SWS_Rte_89016] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_SchM_Init ⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_SchM_Init
Syntax
void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_SchM_Init (
void
)
Service ID [hex]
0xF0
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Rte_Rips_SchM_Init initializes those RTE Implementation Plug-In parts which are relevant for
the SchM related operations.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
⌋
[SWS_Rte_80051]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00101, SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00304
⌈The RTE shall call the init functions Rte_Rips_SchM_Init of all participating RTE
Implementation Plug-Ins in SchM_Init.⌋
